meta.title: Character avatar
meta.description: Restart DSH after installing. Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, with saved avatar + ID presets you can switch between on this device. Any reply can be read aloud with the system voice or your own TTS service (local by default, LAN/remote optional; tone and speed adjustable), with a control bar for pause and sentence skipping. The plugin UI itself can switch between Chinese and English.
